entry.name: jit.gradient.ui
entry.description: The jit.gradient.ui object provides a handy GUI for creating and manipulating 4-plane 1-dimensional gradient matrices. Functionality is similar to the jit.gradient object.

messages.name: alpha_last
messages.digest: Set which plane contains the alpha values (default = 0)
messages.description: The word, followed by a zero or 1, sets which plane in the matrix contains the alpha values (default = 0). Whenis disabled (set to 0). the output format is ARGB. Whenis enabled (set to 1). the output format is RGBA.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Amessage will cause the object to send the current gradient matrix out the object's outlet.

messages.name: clear
messages.digest: Clear all colors but the first
messages.description: The wordwill clear all colors from the matrix except for the first (index 0).

messages.name: move_pointer
messages.description: The word, followed by an integer which specifies the pointer index and a floating-point number in the range 0. - 1.0 will position the pointer index along the range of the gradient.

messages.name: output_matrix_dim
messages.description: The word, followed by an integer, specifies the dimension (size) of the gradient matrix. The size is related to the gradient resolution of the output matrix; a smaller size will result in a gradient with fewer shades.

messages.name: pointer_color
messages.description: The word, followed by an integer which specifies the pointer index and four floating-point numbers in the range 0. - 1.0 sets the color for a pointer index along the range of the gradient.
